title: Generated Object v1 (aroomi-shape-v1)
description: Serializable DATA describing one small new 2D vector decoration generated by the model: a room background piece, a speech-bubble frame or a small room prop, as a flat list of restricted shapes. It is never SVG text, markup or code: the server validates and normalizes it, the client only renders validated data. This schema covers the STRUCTURAL part only (keys, types, enums, counts, patterns, coarse numeric ranges). The following checks are validator-enforced (design/tools/aroomi-shape/validate.mjs) because JSON Schema cannot express them: palette allowlist (app palette tokens + room day wall/floor); duplicate palette colors; coordinates and shape bounds within [-8, viewBox+8] and at most 2 decimals; the longer viewBox side being 128..512 (prop: 64..256); props: at most 30 shapes (schema) and complexityScore <= 45, and the PROP_FACE_LIKE heuristic (eyes-and-mouth look-alike guard: two or more small dark ellipses side by side inside a larger body shape plus a short curved path below them; crude, not a guarantee); path grammar (absolute M L H V C Q Z only, argument counts, at most 48 commands, plain decimals) and path bounding box; poly area; shape fill index against the palette length; fill null together with stroke false; label URL/phone-like rejection; complexityScore (shapes + pathCommands/4 + polyPoints/6) <= 60 (prop: 45); whole document <= 12 KB; and for bubble_frame: textArea inside the viewBox and at least 40% x 25% of it, text-to-fill contrast >= 4.5 against #3A261C, a rect/ellipse/poly cover shape with fill == textFill that contains the textArea, no later shape drawn over the textArea, and tail within the bleed. The renderer draws the outline (#4A3426) and the cream rim (#FFF4DF) itself; neither is part of the document. There are no opacity, gradient, filter, transform, clip, mask, text, image, reference or animation features by design.

layerHint.description: Placement hint. background_piece: wall | floor | backdrop | window_view. prop: floor | wall | shelf. bubble_frame: none.

label.description: Short human label: Hangul, Latin, Kana, digits, space and . , ' - only. URL-like text, phone-like digit runs and control characters are additionally rejected by the validator.

viewBox.description: Origin is always 0,0. The longer side must be 128..512 (validator-enforced).

anchor.description: Pivot (0..1 of the viewBox) the app uses when it places the object.

palette.description: FILL colors only (uppercase #RRGGBB). Each must be on the app palette allowlist (validator-enforced).

shapes.description: Drawn in order (later shapes on top).

textFill.description: Palette index of the fill that sits behind the text (bubble_frame only).

coordinate.description: Range is checked against the actual viewBox by the validator (-8 .. size+8, at most 2 decimals).

fillIndex.description: Palette index, or null for no fill. The index is checked against the palette length by the validator.

textArea.description: Rectangle reserved for text. Must lie inside the viewBox and be at least 40% x 25% of it (validator-enforced).

stroke.description: true draws the outline (and the cream rim under it).

rx.description: Corner radius (used for both axes); at most min(w,h)/2 (validator-enforced).

poly.description: Closed polygon (the last point connects to the first).

path.description: Fill implicitly closes every subpath; the outline is open unless the path contains Z. Grammar and the 48-command limit are validator-enforced.

d.description: Absolute uppercase M L H V C Q Z only; plain decimals with at most 2 decimals; no exponent, no NaN/Infinity.
